lane: wave-1124-sansio T0 (make the gate real), the no_std check of D173
area: tools/ratchets/, scripts/src/bin/ambient/sansio.rs, scripts/src/bin/thirdparty.rs, the root justfile
annoyance: tools/ratchets/sans-io.txt, which the CI step `sans-IO and bstd only go down` checks, was never written: the step fails on any tree until `sansio-write` runs. There was no one command that runs the whole gate by hand (no justfile), so a lane could not tell which lists its change moves without reading the workflow; and nothing computed which crates the shipped binaries reach, though D170 and D173 judge only those.
workaround: T0 adds `just lint`, `just lint-write` and `just lint-report`; thirdparty.rs writes tools/ratchets/reached.txt (the crates blaze-cli and blaze-launcher reach by normal and build dependencies) and its `check` holds it to the manifests; sansio.rs reads it for the `bare` column. The first `just lint-write` makes sans-io.txt and reached.txt.
fix: A gate step that every file the gate reads exists and has a writer the gate runs; `just lint` as the one local entry, kept equal to the CI steps by a test that compares their lists of commands.
